experiment.title: your agents don't have a memory problem, your org does
experiment.hook: your agents remember fine. your org forgets.
experiment.hypothesis: a reframe-diagnosis hook ('not a memory problem, an org problem') anchored by a 7-field handoff framework slide maximizes screenshot-saves vs a single-number payoff
experiment.caption:
someone told me their agents have a memory problem and i pushed back kind of hard, maybe too hard. because it's not the agents. the agents are fine. the problem is you handed off with a three-line summary and expected the next one to inherit an entire company's worth of context from it. a summary tells you what happened. it doesn't carry why it matters — the quality bar, the decision you already made and killed, the budget, the thing you're NOT allowed to do. so the next agent re-derives all of it from scratch and of course it drifts. that's not a memory problem, that's an org that never wrote down how it thinks. so we compile the handoff — goal + definition of done + decisions and why + permissions + budget + confidence + next action — and anything under the bar loops back before it ever hits your desk. the next agent needs more than a summary. it needs the org to actually remember

#aiagents #agentmemory #aiinfra #multiagent #contextengineering #buildinpublic #mcp #devtools

slides.headline: your agents remember fine. your org forgets.
slides.subtext: the fix isn't a bigger context window.

slides.headline: you hand off with a summary. the next agent inherits vibes.
slides.subtext: then re-derives everything you already decided.

slides.headline: it guesses the goal, guesses the bar, repeats the mistake.
slides.subtext: drift isn't a model flaw. it's a handoff flaw.

slides.headline: a summary tells what happened. a handoff carries why it matters.
slides.subtext: why is the part that keeps work on the rails.

slides.headline: what a real handoff actually carries:
slides.subtext: goal · definition of done · decisions+why · permissions · budget · confidence · next action

slides.headline: below the quality bar? it loops back before it reaches you.
slides.subtext: the bar is owner-authored. versionable. yours.

slides.headline: the artifact returns with version, provenance, review state, receipt.
the next agent needs more than a summary.
slides.subtext: follow — i'm building the context layer under your AI clients.
